references.shows: The neutral side view shows both long handslide rails, the rear tuning bow and the mouthpiece near the inner slide brace.
Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.

silhouette: Long paired slide with a narrow return bend below the forward-facing bell.
features: Two straight, parallel slide tubes with one U bend
Separate bell section with a rear return bend
Mouthpiece at the player end below the bell tube
Short stays between the slide tubes
iconFeatures: Long paired slide with a narrow U at the tip.
Bell flare above the slide and a separate rear tuning bow.
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: The neutral catalogue photo of the YSL-354 guides the silhouette and visible tube routing. The illustration simplifies overlapping plumbing from the side.

geometry.view: Neutral catalogue side view in playing orientation
geometry.proportions: The bell ends about three fifths of the way from the rear tuning curve to the slide tip. The two long slide rails stay parallel.
geometry.partLayout: Set the mouthpiece below the bell branch at the start of the upper rail. Carry the lower rail back into the rear tuning bow and from there into the upper bell branch.

documentedDimensions.value: 204.4 mm bell diameter and 12.7 mm bore; bell diameter is about 16 times the bore
